description: Issue #839 AC4 in the HERITAGE `to` spelling: `to forward :n … end` is `ol-reserved-word` exactly as `define forward` is, and the turtle command that follows never runs. Heritage is "alternate spellings only" (`spec/conformance.md:150`), so the declaration slot cannot be more permissive in one spelling than the other — otherwise a learner writing Heritage could shadow `forward` while a learner writing Core could not, which is the profile-dependent unpredictability `spec/grammar.md` rules out. Paired with `to-twice-is-not-a-silent-override`, which covers the duplicate half of the same slot. The span starts at column 4, not 8, because `to` is three characters — the property that made a hard-coded column in the unit suite fail, and the reason a `define`-only corpus could not have caught a keyword-sensitive guard.

diagnostics.message: forward is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
